note: Sides are the character's own; she faces the viewer, so her left is on screen right.

groove.down_l.description: samba no pé: a quick flat step down onto the bent left leg, the right foot just behind on its toe with the heel raised, hips dropped and swung out to her left, samba arms with the elbows out and both forearms loose at waist height, the hands flicking, head bobbing, a big joyful open-mouthed smile

groove.pass_l.description: samba no pé: a quick ball change, the right foot tucked just behind the left on its ball, both knees springy and bent, hips swinging back through the middle, the left forearm flicked up in front of the chest and the right forearm out to the side, a big joyful smile

groove.up_l.description: samba no pé: stepping down onto the bent left leg again, the right foot just behind on its toe, hips swinging to her left, the right forearm flicked up in front of the chest and the left forearm out to the side, head bobbing, a big joyful smile

groove.pass_l2.description: samba no pé: the hip rolled out high to her left over the straight left leg, the right foot flicked out to the side on its toe, the left fist on the hip, the right arm raised high in a flourish, shoulders shimmying, head tilted back, laughing

groove.down_r.description: samba no pé: a quick flat step down onto the bent right leg, the left foot just behind on its toe with the heel raised, hips dropped and swung out to her right, samba arms with the elbows out and both forearms loose at waist height, the hands flicking, head bobbing, a big joyful open-mouthed smile

groove.pass_r.description: samba no pé: a quick ball change, the left foot tucked just behind the right on its ball, both knees springy and bent, hips swinging back through the middle, the right forearm flicked up in front of the chest and the left forearm out to the side, a big joyful smile

groove.up_r.description: samba no pé: stepping down onto the bent right leg again, the left foot just behind on its toe, hips swinging to her right, the left forearm flicked up in front of the chest and the right forearm out to the side, head bobbing, a big joyful smile

groove.pass_r2.description: samba no pé: the hip rolled out high to her right over the straight right leg, the left foot flicked out to the side on its toe, the right fist on the hip, the left arm raised high in a flourish, shoulders shimmying, head tilted back, laughing

left_hand.prep.description: crouched low with weight on the bent right leg, right fist on the hip, left hand scooped down low in front of the left hip, torso turned away to her right, head glancing down at the left hand

left_hand.peak.description: weight on the straight right foot, right hip pushed out, right fist on the hip, body leaning toward her left so one long diagonal runs from the right foot to the left palm thrust high and out at about 45 degrees, left foot on its toe out to the side, head turned up toward the raised hand

left_hand.follow.description: same diagonal pushed further: left arm reaching higher and the palm rolling forward, torso leaning further toward her left, right elbow pushed back on the hip, left toe touch out wider, head following the hand

left_hand.return.description: left arm sweeping down in an arc at shoulder height with the elbow bent, right hand low on the hip, both feet flat and close, torso returning upright

right_hand.prep.description: crouched low with weight on the bent left leg, left fist on the hip, right hand scooped down low in front of the right hip, torso turned away to her left, head glancing down at the right hand

right_hand.peak.description: weight on the straight left foot, left hip pushed out, left fist on the hip, body leaning toward her right so one long diagonal runs from the left foot to the right palm thrust high and out at about 45 degrees, right foot on its toe out to the side, head turned up toward the raised hand

right_hand.follow.description: same diagonal pushed further: right arm reaching higher and the palm rolling forward, torso leaning further toward her right, left elbow pushed back on the hip, right toe touch out wider, head following the hand

right_hand.return.description: right arm sweeping down in an arc at shoulder height with the elbow bent, left hand low on the hip, both feet flat and close, torso returning upright

left_foot.prep.description: weight on the bent right leg, left knee lifted forward and out with the foot off the floor and the toe pointing down, left fist on the hip, right arm low and out for balance, head looking down at the left foot

left_foot.peak.description: heel dig: left leg stretched out on a forward diagonal with the left heel on the floor and the toe up, weight on the bent right leg, chest proud and leaning back slightly, right fist on the hip, left arm low and back, head turned toward the left foot

left_foot.follow.description: left heel still dug in on the diagonal, hip popped over the right foot, shoulders tilted against the hips, right elbow pushed back on the hip, left arm low and out, head on the left foot

left_foot.return.description: left foot dragged back along the floor to close beside the right, both feet flat, knees soft, arms relaxed low at the sides

right_foot.prep.description: weight on the bent left leg, right knee lifted forward and out with the foot off the floor and the toe pointing down, right fist on the hip, left arm low and out for balance, head looking down at the right foot

right_foot.peak.description: heel dig: right leg stretched out on a forward diagonal with the right heel on the floor and the toe up, weight on the bent left leg, chest proud and leaning back slightly, left fist on the hip, right arm low and back, head turned toward the right foot

right_foot.follow.description: right heel still dug in on the diagonal, hip popped over the left foot, shoulders tilted against the hips, left elbow pushed back on the hip, right arm low and out, head on the right foot

right_foot.return.description: right foot dragged back along the floor to close beside the left, both feet flat, knees soft, arms relaxed low at the sides

enter_forward.contact_l.description: swaggering walk toward the viewer on a slight diagonal, left heel landing in front, right foot behind on its toe, right fist on the hip, left arm swinging back, chin up

enter_forward.down_l.description: weight dropping into the bent left knee, left hip high, right foot pushing off behind on its toe, right fist on the hip, left arm swinging, head dipping on the beat

enter_forward.pass_l.description: standing tall on the straight left leg, right knee swinging forward past it, right fist on the hip, left arm relaxed at the side, chin up

enter_forward.contact_r.description: swaggering walk toward the viewer on a slight diagonal, right heel landing in front, left foot behind on its toe, right fist on the hip, left arm swinging forward, chin up

enter_forward.down_r.description: weight dropping into the bent right knee, right hip high, left foot pushing off behind on its toe, right fist on the hip, left arm swinging forward, head dipping on the beat

enter_forward.pass_r.description: standing tall on the straight right leg, left knee swinging forward past it, right fist on the hip, left arm relaxed at the side, chin up

retreat_backward.contact_l.description: stepping backward while still facing the viewer, left foot reaching back onto its ball, weight still on the flat right foot, left hand behind the back, right arm low and loose

retreat_backward.down_l.description: weight rolled back onto the bent left leg, left hip high, right foot in front with the toe lifted, left hand behind the back, right arm low and forward, head nodding

retreat_backward.pass_l.description: right foot dragged back along the floor past the straight left leg, left hand behind the back, right arm hanging loose, chin up

retreat_backward.contact_r.description: stepping backward while still facing the viewer, right foot reaching back onto its ball, weight still on the flat left foot, left hand behind the back, right arm low and loose

retreat_backward.down_r.description: weight rolled back onto the bent right leg, right hip high, left foot in front with the toe lifted, left hand behind the back, right arm low, head nodding

retreat_backward.pass_r.description: left foot dragged back along the floor past the straight right leg, left hand behind the back, right arm hanging loose, chin up

yield_side.contact_l.description: side-step toward the sideline: left leg reaching out sideways with the foot landing, weight still on the bent right leg, right fist on the hip, left arm out low

yield_side.down_l.description: weight shifted onto the bent left leg, left hip high and pushed out, right foot trailing on its toe, right fist on the hip, head nodding

yield_side.pass_l.description: right foot dragged in along the floor to close beside the straight left leg, right fist on the hip, left arm relaxed at the side

yield_side.contact_r.description: right foot stepping back on a diagonal onto its ball, left knee bent, arms low and loose, torso turning open

yield_side.down_r.description: weight settled onto the bent right leg, right hip high, left foot in front with the toe lifted, right forearm coming forward at waist height

yield_side.pass_r.description: standing on the right leg, left fist on the hip, right arm held out low and wide with the palm open and up toward the empty floor, head turned toward the open palm with a slight bow, offering the floor

watch.shift_l.description: relaxed stance turned slightly to her left, hands clasped behind the back, weight on the left foot with the left hip high, right knee soft, head turned to watch the other dancer

watch.hold_l.description: hands clasped behind the back, weight sunk on the left foot with both knees softer, head nodding along to the music while watching

watch.shift_r.description: relaxed stance turned slightly to her left, hands clasped behind the back, weight on the right foot with the right hip high, left knee soft, head turned to watch the other dancer

watch.hold_r.description: hands clasped behind the back, weight sunk on the right foot with both knees softer, head tilted with a small nod while watching

clap.open.description: standing square and upright, both forearms raised in front of the chest with the palms apart and facing each other, elbows out, chin up

clap.close.description: both hands swinging together in front of the chest, elbows out, knees starting to bend, head starting to nod

clap.contact.description: palms clapped together in front of the chest, elbows out to the sides, both knees dipped, head nodding down with a smile

clap.release.description: hands bouncing apart in front of the chest, elbows out, knees rising, head level

challenge.load.description: back-break dip: weight sunk on the bent left leg, right foot back on its ball, torso leaning forward, both hands travelling toward the hips, head lowered

challenge.proud.description: proud stance: both fists on the hips with the elbows out, chest pushed out and leaning back, chin raised, weight on the straight right leg, left heel set forward with the toe up

challenge.offer.description: courteous invitation: weight on the right leg, left fist on the hip, right arm sweeping out low and forward with the palm open and up toward the floor, torso bowing slightly forward, head bowed toward the open hand

challenge.return.description: both feet flat, standing easy, right forearm relaxed in front, left hand low near the hip, body upright

approval.load.description: small inhale: chest lifted and leaning back slightly, chin raised, weight on the right foot, arms loose and slightly away from the body

approval.nod.description: right palm pressed flat to the chest, a deep nod with the head bowed, both knees dipped, left arm low and out at the side

approval.release.description: left fist on the hip, right arm held out forward at waist height with the palm open toward the viewer, head tilted warmly

reassurance.notice.description: head tilted to her right with a soft warm look, weight on the left foot, arms relaxed low, right forearm slightly forward

reassurance.open_hand.description: small friendly shrug: both forearms out at waist height with the palms open and up, the right hand a little higher, both knees softly bent, head tilted

reassurance.settle.description: a back-break step on the spot: weight on the bent left knee, right foot back on its ball, left forearm forward, right arm low and back, inviting the rhythm back

finish_turn.finish_a.description: weight on the straight right leg, left heel set forward with the toe up, left fist on the hip, the right hand rising to the big curls beside her head, chest proud, chin up

finish_turn.finish_b.description: the right hand fluffing the big curls at her temple with a flourish, head tilted, chest proud, left elbow out with the fist on the hip, left heel forward with the toe up, a delighted grin

finish_turn.turn_in.description: body turned about 30 degrees toward her left on a heel pivot, leaning into the turn, left arm open out to the side at hip height, right fist on the hip

finish_turn.turn_out.description: body turned about 30 degrees toward her right on a heel pivot, leaning into the turn, right arm open out to the side at hip height, left fist on the hip

spin.front.description: facing the viewer in the middle of a joyful spin on the spot, both arms raised high and open, the feather boa flying out

spin.34_r.description: turned three-quarters toward the right of the picture, spinning on the spot, both arms raised, the feather boa flying out

spin.side_r.description: in profile facing the right of the picture, spinning on the spot, both arms raised, the feather boa flying out

spin.back34_r.description: turned mostly away from the viewer, the face hidden, spinning on the spot, the back of the big curly hair showing, both arms raised

spin.back.description: seen from directly behind in the middle of a spin, only the back of her big curly hair and the back of the gold dress showing, both arms raised, the feather boa round the shoulders

spin.back34_l.description: turned mostly away from the viewer, the face hidden, spinning on the spot, the back of the big curly hair showing, both arms raised

spin.side_l.description: in profile facing the left of the picture, spinning on the spot, both arms raised, the feather boa flying out

spin.34_l.description: turned three-quarters toward the left of the picture, coming back round to the viewer, both arms raised high and open, laughing

boa.a.description: standing easy on the right leg, twirling the feather boa: the left hand on the left of the picture held high above the head holding one end of the boa, the right hand low by the hip holding the other end, the boa looping round behind her shoulders, head tilted, a playful grin

boa.b.description: standing easy on the left leg, twirling the feather boa the other way: the right hand on the right of the picture held high above the head holding one end of the boa, the left hand low by the hip holding the other end, the boa swinging out in a wide loop, head tilted, laughing

laugh.a.description: a big laugh: leaning back with the head thrown back, mouth wide open laughing and eyes squeezed shut, the right hand pressed flat on the chest, the left arm loose at the side, shoulders up

laugh.b.description: a big belly laugh: leaning back with the head thrown right back, mouth wide open laughing and eyes squeezed shut, both hands on the belly, shoulders shaking, the left foot lifted off the floor with the toe pointed

kiss.a.description: turned a little toward the right of the picture, the left fist on the hip, the right fingertips pressed to the puckered lips, eyes twinkling, about to blow a kiss

kiss.b.description: turned a little toward the right of the picture, blowing a kiss: the right arm flung out toward the right of the picture at shoulder height with the palm open and up, lips puckered, the left fist on the hip, a wink

confetti.a.description: a samba step onto the bent left leg, leaning forward, both hands cupped together low beside the left hip holding a big handful of colourful paper confetti, looking down at it with a cheeky grin

confetti.b.description: throwing confetti: both arms flung up high and wide above the head, a shower of colourful paper confetti bursting from both open hands into the air, leaning back, head thrown back, mouth wide open laughing
